profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Optum Behavioral Care
profile.summary:
From dance to code, when I start a journey I immerse myself in all the experiences that accompany a craft. I'm an avid proponent of consistent dedication to art and of inspiration through representation of one's passion. 

I thoroughly enjoy the art of programming. To take bits of code and build powerful applications that can effect change on the world is magic. I strive to become a technical wizard and make the world a fun and happy place with the wave of my fingers. 

The programming culture is rich and abound with amazing people who are willing to share the treasure trove of knowledge that they have accumulated. I thrive in collaborative settings, working with others to attain substantive goals. I continue to learn and sharpen my skills so that I can share and help create an even more amazing world.

positions.title: Software Engineer, Internal Tools
positions.description:
• Collaborate with HR, IT and Recruiting to create a RESTful internal employee lifecycle management application in React, Redux, and Ruby on Rails that automates account creation and standardizes the employee onboarding process, while adapting to the latest conventions of ES10, React v16, Redux v4, and Rails 5.
• Spearhead the creation of a microservice in Ruby on Rails that interfaces with the company’s HRIS system (Paycom) and aggregates employee data to be utilized as a single source of truth for several internal systems
• Develop scripts that range from auditing employee accounts and flagging inconsistencies via tickets in Zendesk to automating the download and upload of all personal HelloSign files of a specified user into a secure file share
• Actively maintain, manage access and enforce security protocols for AWS services (EC2, IAM, S3), Google services (Analytics, GSuite, Tag Manager), Github Enterprise, Heroku Enterprise and Okta

positions.title: Tools Engineer
positions.locationName: 350 Fifth Avenue,  21st Floor New York, NY 10118
positions.description:
• Developed onboarding application to streamline IT’s account creation workflow by connecting systems, such as Active Directory, LDAP, and Google, via APIs and by assembling the account creation methods into a comprehensive checklist
• Redesigned careers page by leveraging Greenhouse’s integration services and by setting up the necessary routing to guide prospective candidates to their desired job openings
• Integrated a card reader application that, when employees scan their badges at the IT tech bar, generates a ticket within Jira, which facilitates the documentation of IT requests and expands the reporting of tech bar walkups
• Maintained and enhanced the functionality of several internal web pages, in particular the People site and the Employee portal, by redesigning ineffective processes, patchings bugs, and improving the user experience, all while openly communicating with stakeholders
• Resolved over 3000 tickets as an IT support member, which ranged from fixing hardware/software issues to provisioning laptops in order to gain insight on how to better automate manual IT processes

positions.title: Mentor
positions.description:
• Coached students during code challenges and guided them to solutions that matched their learning pace and style
• Provided code reviews, lightning talks, and breakout sessions on new languages, frameworks, and technologies
• Pair programmed with students to give insight into alternative problem solving methods and communication skills

positions.title: Accountant
positions.description:
• Performed standard A/P & A/R Accounting processes with Invoices, PO’s, Checks, and Credit Cards.
• Assisted Controller with monthly Bank Reconciliations.
• Reconciled accounts (checking for errors, balancing, and verifying original documents) and prepared       reports.
• Ensured accurate reporting of financial information whilst maintaining accounting principles.

positions.title: Accouting Clerk
positions.locationName: 570 Washington St., Ste. 2A New York, NY 10014
positions.description:
• Fulfilled standard accounts payable duties and developed a deeper awareness of film accounting and production processes. 
• Refined bookkeeping skills and facilitate file organization for internal audit and post-production (wrap). 
• Entered, processed, and audited Purchase Orders into Accounting software and pair POs with corresponding Invoices.

positions.title: Assistant Production Accountant
positions.description:
•Performed standard accounts payable and accounts receivable duties (liaison for CollegeHumor Production with IAC Finance). 
•Entered, processed, and audited American Express, Invoice, Petty Cash, and Payroll (Entertainment Partners) expenses to create Weekly Cost Reports for annual budgeting purposes. 
•Developed ownership for personal accounting responsibilities, recommended methods to facilitate production accounting processes during weekly finance meetings and implemented them.

positions.title: Assistant Production Accountant (Intern)
positions.description:
•Audited and created spreadsheets for cash ﬂow adjustments to union member’s hours and rates to account for overhead under the senior accountant’s supervision. 
•Maintained and organized ﬁles of vendors, goods purchased, total amount payable, amount paid, last date of payment, mode of transactions, etc. 
•Verified the details on invoices, contacted vendors, resolved variations, and inputted data into the accounting system (GlobalVista).

positions.title: Summer Business Development Intern
positions.description:
•Carried out client presentations with CityJet, Standard Hotel, and World of Dance executives expressing the value plan of MBMRecord’s products, solutions, and service offerings. 
•Offered management with suggestions for developing volume, market shares and maintaining cost levels.

positions.title: Field Manager
positions.description:
•Built up campaign support by personally raising thousands of dollars and introducing new members to the ACLU/ ASPCA organization. 
•Coordinated training exercises for prospective employees to maximize budget quotas to fulfill projected goal of $1,000,000 over a course of 3 months and set an example by being one of the nation’s top Canvassers.

projects.title: Cash-Flows
projects.description: Helps small businesses manage their payables and receivables. Our target users are small businesses who want to better manage complexities for their payables and receivables, predict their cash needs, as well as to avoid bad customers/suppliers or renegotiate bad terms. This project was built with Ruby on Rails, javascript, html, css and uses several ruby gems such as foundation and highcharts.

projects.title: Tettrogleable
projects.description:
Tettrogleable is a realtime game built by a 5-person team for our final project at DBC. It has a Ruby on Rails backbone, and is developed with html5, css, and vanilla javascript. It's three awesome games in one: Tetris, Boggle, and Scrabble. It's the ultimate in speed vs. wit, dexterity vs. vocabularity, literati vs. Maserati. In short, it's the strategy/word game of the future. 
And the future is now!
